hotspots.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates
hotspots.blurb: Public spat between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian PM Giorgia Meloni over a G7 photo incident has intensified, with Trump making derogatory remarks and Meloni defending her actions. The feud has sparked diplomatic tensions and media frenzy.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-profile nature, involving two major Western leaders, and the moral and political stakes in U.S.-Italy relations.

hotspots.title: Manuel Adorni scandal deepens
hotspots.blurb: Argentine government spokesperson Manuel Adorni faces allegations of illicit enrichment and misuse of public funds. Opposition parties are pushing for his interpellation in Congress, while the ruling party attempts to delay proceedings.
hotspots.affect: The scandal commands attention due to its implications for government transparency, corruption, and political stability in Argentina.

hotspots.title: Magyar’s corruption crackdown intensifies
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian PM Péter Magyar has launched 'Operation Clean Fire,' a sweeping anti-corruption initiative targeting former officials and proposing constitutional changes to remove the president and limit parliamentary terms.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its dramatic framing as a purge of past corruption and the high stakes of constitutional reform in Hungary.

hotspots.title: Vox-PP coalition tensions in Spain
hotspots.blurb: Negotiations between Spain's Vox and Partido Popular (PP) for regional governments have stalled, with Vox accusing PP of breaking agreements and demanding policy concessions. The tensions highlight broader right-wing coalition dynamics in Spain.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes nature of coalition politics, moral framing of betrayal, and the potential impact on regional governance.

hotspots.title: AfD surges in German polls
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to lead in polls for upcoming state elections, particularly in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Sachsen-Anhalt. The party's rise has sparked debates over its influence and mainstream parties' responses.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the alarm over far-right gains, polarized contention over migration and governance, and the moral stakes of democratic resilience.
